capabilities: Search IGDB or Games Never Die for game metadata
Create game notes from configurable Markdown templates
Browse and filter a local backlog library by status, platform and genre
Log dated play sessions with optional minutes into the note
Refresh source properties with a per-field conflict review
disambiguation: Not a game launcher or emulator; it only creates and organizes Markdown notes about games.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7+; English lookups need a Twitch application for IGDB credentials, and the Client Secret is kept as an Obsidian SecretStorage reference. A demo MP4 is linked in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up game metadata, track a game backlog, or keep play sessions attached to a game note.

relations.evidence: It creates ordinary Markdown notes using Games Never Die for Japanese game data or IGDB for English game data.
Games Never Die supplies Japanese metadata; IGDB supplies its original game data, generally in English.
Basic metadata, ratings, store links, overview, articles, media, and optional Steam data.

requires.name: IGDB (Twitch application) Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Creates Markdown game notes from IGDB or Games Never Die data, with a local backlog library and dated play journals.
